summary: Point 19 (Retailer Staff Incentive Platform) fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass in test_point19_staff.py plus 4/4 regression tests from iteration_31. Admin /staff-incentives page works with 4 tabs (Staff, Leaderboard, Redemptions, Slabs), KPI cards, Add Staff dialog creates staff (HL-XXXX code), QR modal renders base64 PNG with wa.me URL containing #STAFF:token, activate/deactivate toggle works, Slabs config editable + Save Config, Redemptions empty state present, Leaderboard renders. Staff mini-app at /staff-app is fully separate (own dark theme, own auth context), phone+OTP login with dev bypass 1234 works, dashboard shows Total Earned + Registrations + Bill Uploads + How-to-earn, tab bar (Home/Earnings/My QR/Redeem) navigation works, QR page shows QR image + staff_code + brand + Share/Copy + prefilled WhatsApp message, Redeem shows ₹0 balance with amount+submit both disabled at 0 balance, logout returns to /staff-app/login. Consumer (/app), admin (/login), staff-app/login all return 200 - no regressions.

minor.issue: Default registration_slabs has 4 entries (0-10,11-25,26-50,51+) rather than 3 as stated in problem statement. Bill-upload slabs correctly has 3. Not a bug per se, admin-configurable, but worth confirming spec.

issues: Toggle button uses plain text ('Deactivate'/'Activate') without confirmation dialog - could benefit from confirmation for accidental clicks, minor UX polish

action_items: (Optional) Reconcile default registration_slabs count (4) with problem statement (3) - if spec truly requires 3, remove one slab in DEFAULT_REG_SLABS in routes/staff.py; else update spec docs.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/staff.py is well-scoped and self-contained; STAFF_MSG_PATTERN regex verified.
Staff mini-app correctly isolates auth via own StaffAuthProvider - no leakage into admin routes; /staff-app does not redirect to /login (admin) which was a stated risk.

OTP boxes: only the first input has maxLength=6 (paste-friendly) which is a nice trick but may confuse users manually typing digit-by-digit since remaining boxes have maxLength=1 without auto-advance visible in code path. Consider auto-focus advance on input.
All critical interactive elements have data-testid attributes - excellent for regression.
